# Sea Dog Marine

> Sea Dog Marine is a marine cleaning and maintenance company serving waterfront property owners in Pinellas, Hillsborough and Manatee counties, Florida (Tampa Bay). Call or text 727-699-4920 for a free video inspection.

## Key facts
- Business name: Sea Dog Marine
- Phone (call or text): 727-699-4920
- Service area: Pinellas County, Hillsborough County and Manatee County, Florida
- Cities: St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Largo, Seminole, Dunedin, Tarpon Springs, Palm Harbor, Treasure Island, St. Pete Beach, Madeira Beach, Indian Rocks Beach, Redington Shores, Belleair, Gulfport, Tierra Verde, Oldsmar, Safety Harbor, Tampa, Davis Islands, Harbour Island, Apollo Beach, Ruskin, Gibsonton, Rocky Point, Westshore, South Tampa, Riverview, Town 'n' Country, Bradenton, Palmetto, Anna Maria Island, Holmes Beach, Bradenton Beach, Anna Maria, Cortez, Longboat Key, Ellenton, Terra Ceia, Snead Island
- Removes: algae, barnacles, oysters, mold and marine growth
- Dive services: in-water hull and boat bottom cleaning, zinc anode replacement and propeller cleaning at the customer's dock, lift or slip
- Free video inspections: text a video or photos for a same day quote
- Hours: Monday to Friday: 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday: 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM
